description:
Add a `release_id` TEXT column and index to the LPBS `download_artifacts` table. This is a lightweight foreign correlation key (not a FK constraint, since it references a different database) that links LPBS artifacts back to deployment-manager release records.

Update the artifact commit handler to accept and store `release_id` from S2D uploads. The S2D pipeline will pass `release_id` in the commit step alongside the existing `git_commit_hash` and `release_version`.
name: lpbs-release-id-correlation-column
title: Add Release ID Correlation Column To LPBS Download Artifacts
